description: Read a niche's daily edition: the stories independent sources back up, each with its independent-source count (after syndicated copies are merged), the outlets and URLs, a one-line why-it-matters, new-vs-continuing status, plus what moved, where the discourse splits and what to watch. Editions are built once a day per niche and shared, so this read is instant and free. Pass a niche slug from the public directory (for example financial-advisors, defense-tech) and optionally a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past edition. A quiet day returns status=quiet with no stories. Returns 'no_edition' when the niche exists but hasn't been built yet, and 'unknown_niche' otherwise.

date.description: Optional edition date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest edition.

name: niche_feed_read
